why: Order-path behaviour change: an evidenced broker wedge stops having a close re-attempted every ~30s and is re-probed hourly instead. It is a CADENCE, not a stop — the hourly re-probe keeps `last_seen` alive so `sweep_vanished` cannot manufacture a `vanished_unattributed` for a position that never moved. Rollback is one env flip (CLOSE_WEDGE_REPROBE_MINUTES=0), no redeploy.
